component.name: Discogs Spinner
component.summary: Browse, spin, and value your Discogs vinyl collection

description.p: Discogs Spinner is a local-first desktop companion for vinyl collectors who already keep a Discogs collection.
Connect a Discogs personal access token, sync your collection and wantlist, spin a random record, inspect market value, and keep daily collector context close without living in browser tabs.

screenshot.caption: Browse your synced record collection as a cover-art gallery.
Spin a record and inspect tracklist, value, and playback context.

description.p: First-run and supportability polish: in-app "Report a problem" link, clearer web setup errors, and quieter first snap launch.
Packaging refresh for recent GTK desktop launch and gallery fixes.
